description: EnergyScope Belgian hourly model, published by EnergyScope contributors, implements the Belgian hourly linear-programming version of EnergyScope. Coverage: The repository identifies this as release v2_2 of the Belgian hourly linear-programming model. It should not be confused with every EnergyScope variant or the separate Python convenience library. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is Apache-2.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
